segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company seeking a business combination with high-growth businesses that have transnational operations.
segments.evidence: We are a blank check company incorporated on October 29, 2024 as a Cayman Islands exempted company and formed for the purpose of effecting a merger, amalgamation, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, or reorganization or engaging in any other similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities, which we refer to throughout this Annual Report as our initial business combination.
